subject.title: PR5/5 durable core: internal session delivery handoff

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this opt-in durable-core runtime and its shared-state, protocol, CLI, and SDK surface, and if so should it be repackaged as a staged main-bound change rather than merged cumulatively onto release/2026.7.1?
rationale: Correctness tests cannot decide whether OpenClaw should own this broad durable orchestration substrate, its twelve-table data model, or its long-term public contracts on an already released branch.

options.title: Sponsor a main-bound staged design
options.body: Repackage the durable runtime and handoff into reviewed dependency stages on main, with explicit migration and exact-head live proof before each public contract lands.

options.title: Approve the release-line stack
options.body: Explicitly accept the cumulative 2026.7.1 branch, durable data model, API surface, and upgrade obligations after the missing latest-head proof is supplied.

options.title: Decline durable core for now
options.body: Close the stack without merging and retain the existing restart and session-delivery primitives until a narrower sponsored design is proposed.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a main-bound staged design
recommendation.body: Repackage the durable runtime and handoff into reviewed dependency stages on main, with explicit migration and exact-head live proof before each public contract lands.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history and the breadth of the release, session-state, and Gateway boundary make steipete the strongest available decision owner.
